lines.text: Type a question, hit enter, now it's gone to the machine,
Chopped up into tokens, little pieces that it's seen,
It don't see letters, only chunks that it knows,
So count the R's in strawberry and watch how it goes,
Every token is a vector, four thousand wide,
Words that mean the same thing end up side by side,
Now the sentence is a stack of numbers standing tall,
Thirty-two floors in the tower and it's gotta climb them all
Just one more token,
One more roll of the dice,
Guess it, pick it, feed it back in,
And do it again all night
Every token looks back at the words that came first,
Asks who matters to me, gives a weight to each word,
The strongest ones pull and it blends what they say,
That's attention, thirty-two heads, each doing it its own way,
Then the feed-forward fires where the facts are kept,
Fourteen thousand neurons every single step,
Attention, feed-forward, that's one floor of the tower,
Stack it thirty-two high, that's where it gets its power
Just one more token,
One more roll of the dice,
Guess it, pick it, feed it back in,
And do it again all night
At the top of the tower every word gets a score,
A hundred twenty-eight thousand, all in the draw,
Softmax turns them into odds with the temperature set,
Keep it low and it's safe, turn it up, it's a bet,
Roll the dice, one token, stick it on the end,
Feed the whole thing back and do it over again,
But the keys and the values that it made, it can keep,
That's the K-V cache, so the past comes cheap
Every single token, it reads every weight,
Sixteen gigs from memory while the math just waits
Stuck on the slope, it's the roofline again,
So read the weights once and serve a hundred of them,
Or a little model guesses four words in a row,
And the big one checks all four in one go
Just one more token,
One more roll of the dice,
Guess it, pick it, feed it back in,
And do it again all night
One more token,
Till it picks the one that says it's done

extras.desc: backing-vocal tail / 'ah' ad-lib after 'eyes' over the break (chorus 1 end)
lead-in before 'Just transformers': Whisper hears a stuttered 'Just, just, just' (low confidence)
sustained backing 'ah' pad under 'I'm upping my P(doom)' (final chorus) - lead is buried here
outro chant: repeated 'oh' / 'oh-oh' vocal hook (Whisper: 'Oh, oh, oh...') until the drums stop at ~153

notes: Song: 'Chasing the Roofline' (ACE-Step 1.5 XL take a4-401, audio/roofline.wav, mp3 is the gapless encode of it). Method as for pdoom (analysis/align.py): CTC emissions of the Demucs htdemucs_ft vocal stem from MMS_FA and wav2vec2-lv60k on mono, left and right, fused; one global constrained Viterbi pass with a garbage star token between lines; phonetic spellings for the CUDA terms (pron.py: PyTorch='pie torch', cudaMemcpy='cuda mem copy', GPU='gee pee you', MNIST='em nist', cuBLAS='cue blas', KV='kay vee', float4='float four', MMA='em em ay', N-by-N='en by en', NormalFloat4='normal float four', NVLink='en vee link', CUTLASS='cut lass'); signal refinement on the vocal stem; cross-check against mlx-whisper; conf as for pdoom. 'syl' = start/end of each spelled letter or compound part.
